title: The 5 Most Common Elements in Earth's Crust, Ranked (#1 Is a Gas)

scenes.text: The five most common elements in Earth's crust. Number one is something you're breathing right now.
Number five: calcium. About four percent of the crust, the stuff of limestone and chalk.
scenes.label: Calcium · 4.2%

scenes.text: Number four: iron. Only five point six percent. Most of Earth's iron is down in the core.
scenes.label: Iron · 5.6%

scenes.text: Number three: aluminium. Eight percent, the most common metal in the crust.
scenes.label: Aluminium · 8.2%

scenes.text: Number two: silicon. Twenty-eight percent, in sand, quartz and nearly every rock.
scenes.label: Silicon · 28.2%

scenes.text: Number one: oxygen. Forty-six percent by weight, locked inside rock.
scenes.label: Oxygen · 46.1%

description:
The five most common elements in Earth's crust, ranked by share of the crust's mass.
Oxygen is number one at 46 percent, but it's locked inside rock, not floating in the air.
Which one did you expect at number one?
first_comment: Which element surprised you most? And what should we rank next?
